data: API-Football v3: results + per-match statistics (xG, shots on target, total shots)

protocol.dc: Dixon-Coles refitted weekly on the past 3 years (xi=0.0019), promoted teams without 6 matches skipped
protocol.reference: league frequency of the market over the past 3 years, recomputed weekly
protocol.enriched: logit per market or Poisson GLM (offset log DC rate) + DC score matrix; refitted weekly on all past rows of the 6 leagues; variant and L2 chosen per market on validation log-loss
protocol.decision_rule: validated iff on the pooled test set Brier(model)<Brier(ref) and LL(model)<LL(ref) with the 95% bootstrap CI of the Brier difference entirely < 0, and in no league Brier(model)-Brier(ref) > 0.002
